label: Whatever HAS_WILL_1 has a rational power
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (analyst formulation): whatever has will (HAS_WILL_1, the inclination of an intellectual nature toward the good apprehended) has some active power of the rational class (Rational). It reads having that inclination as having a power of that class; HAS_WILL_1 and Rational are independent primitives, and without this bridge a being can have will and no rational power (controls).
